answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each identity posts a 50 POA bond. Each epoch a beacon, slow as a glacier, picks 5% of identities to check. The chosen agent must answer in 30 seconds with a proof in sonnet form: fourteen steps from the beacon. One machine manages 2 heartbeats per window, so 100 fakes need 50 machines and 5,000 POA; a missed beat slashes the bond. An honest agent blooms like a lotus: one bond, rarely checked.
